kultivator.gabung.corak.sedang: You are already taking a style trial.
kultivator.gabung.corak.lapangan_dipakai: This sect's trial ground is in use by %1$s. Wait about %2$s seconds.
kultivator.gabung.corak.anggaran: The trial ground is crowded. Try again in a moment.
kultivator.gabung.corak.anggaran_kurang: The trial needs %s free places; wait until the crowd thins.
kultivator.gabung.corak.tidak_bisa: The style trial cannot be set up here.
kultivator.gabung.corak.terbang: No flying on the trial ground. You are set down.
kultivator.gabung.corak.peringatan_wilay: You are leaving the trial ground! Return within 3 seconds.
kultivator.gabung.corak.akhir.sumpah: The vow not to kill was broken
kultivator.gabung.corak.akhir.terlihat: Seen by the guards three times
Six straw dummies light up in turn. Strike the lit one with a sword or spear before it goes dark. A hundred lights; the beat quickens.
Inspired by the hundred-cut drill of sword-sect disciples in xianxia novels.
Three waves of bronze monks bar the corridor. Bring them down; they cannot die. Killing any creature during the trial fails it (the vow).
Inspired by Shaolin's Eighteen Bronze Men (十八铜人) of wuxia lore.
kultivator.gabung.corak.taklukkan_binata: A spirit beast waits in the pen. Bring it down to 20 %% health without killing it, then feed it the food it loves by hand.
Inspired by the spirit-beast taming sects of xianxia novels.
kultivator.gabung.corak.labirin_batu.atu: An unseen maze rises. Step on the three formation eyes in the order of the trigram riddle, then walk out. A wrong eye costs 10 seconds.
kultivator.gabung.corak.labirin_batu.ins: Inspired by Zhuge Liang's Stone Sentinel Maze (八阵图) that misled Lu Xun.
kultivator.gabung.corak.lima_pilar.atura: Visit the five pillars along the Five Phases cycle. Hold right-click on a pillar to raise the Qi needle, release to let it sink; keep it inside the band for 15 seconds. The needle follows with a brief lag: let go before it reaches the band, do not wait.
kultivator.gabung.corak.lima_pilar.inspi: Inspired by the generating cycle of the Five Phases (五行相生).
kultivator.gabung.corak.satu_tungku.atur: Refine any pill at the sect's furnace with the trial box's ingredients within 600 seconds. The pill's quality decides your mark; unused ingredients go back.
kultivator.gabung.corak.satu_tungku.insp: Inspired by the furnace trials of alchemists in xianxia novels.
kultivator.gabung.corak.pikul_gunung.atu: Carry the stone from the foot of the stair to its top. In hand it is heavy; in the pack heavier still. Dropping it costs 10 seconds; losing it fails.
kultivator.gabung.corak.pikul_gunung.ins: Inspired by the Monkey King pinned under Five Finger Mountain.
kultivator.gabung.corak.kolam_darah.atur: Stand in the blood pool while it drinks your life (it stops at 30 %% health; the pool does not kill) and survive three waves of demonic cultivators. Crouch still for 1 second to offer blood for Strength II.
kultivator.gabung.corak.kolam_darah.insp: Inspired by the blood prohibited grounds of demonic-path xianxia novels.
kultivator.gabung.corak.tiga_cawan.atura: Drink from the three poisoned cups one by one. Smell the scent, then pick the right antidote from the five herbs (read each herb's note) within 20 seconds.
kultivator.gabung.corak.tiga_cawan.inspi: Inspired by the Five Poison Sect (五毒教) of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
kultivator.gabung.corak.ujian_senyap.atu: Take the jade task token from the elders' table and carry it out of the guarded ring unseen. Three guards sweep their gaze; crouching shortens their reach. Seen three times fails.
kultivator.gabung.corak.ujian_senyap.ins: Inspired by the infiltration trials of shadow sects in wuxia novels.
A Hundred Cuts begins: %s lights. Strike the lit dummy!
This dummy only counts sword or spear strikes.
Enter the corridor. Fell the bronze men, but kill nothing.
Wave %1$s of %2$s: two bronze men step forward.
You killed %s. The vow not to kill is broken.
kultivator.gabung.corak.taklukkan_binata: A spirit wolf growls in the pen. Bring it to 20 %% health, do not kill it, then feed it meat.
A spirit snow bear growls in the pen. Bring it to 20 %% health, do not kill it, then feed it fish.
Give it by hand to a beast that has bowed.
The beast bows. Now feed it the food it loves.
The beast bows to your spirit beast, not to you. Feed it to finish.
Do not strike a beast that has bowed.
It has not bowed yet; it would bite your hand.
It does not like that food.
The beast eats from your hand. It is tamed.
Your last blow was too heavy. The beast is dead.
kultivator.gabung.corak.labirin_batu.mul: The formation riddle: step on the eye of %1$s, then %2$s, then %3$s. Each eye is flanked by a wall with its trigram.
kultivator.gabung.corak.labirin_batu.ter: All three eyes are lit. Walk out of the maze!
kultivator.gabung.corak.labirin_batu.sal: The wrong eye! The formation holds you 10 seconds.
kultivator.gabung.corak.lima_pilar.mulai: Begin at the %s pillar. Hold right-click on the pillar and keep the Qi needle inside the band.
kultivator.gabung.corak.lima_pilar.bukan: Not this pillar. The Five Phases point to the %s pillar.
kultivator.gabung.corak.lima_pilar.dekat: Step up to the pillar first.
kultivator.gabung.corak.satu_tungku.mula: The sect's furnace is at %1$s %2$s %3$s. Refine one pill with the trial box's ingredients.
No furnace nearby. Set a cauldron on a lit campfire, then refine one pill.
kultivator.gabung.corak.satu_tungku.gaga: The refining failed (attempt %s). There are ingredients left to try again.
kultivator.gabung.corak.pikul_gunung.mul: Carry this stone to %1$s %2$s %3$s (about %4$s blocks). Keep it in your hand.
kultivator.gabung.corak.pikul_gunung.lor: Heavy as a mountain. For the trial only.
kultivator.gabung.corak.pikul_gunung.peg: The stone in your pack weighs more. Hold it in your main hand!
kultivator.gabung.corak.pikul_gunung.jat: The stone fell! You pick it back up (+10 seconds).
kultivator.gabung.corak.kolam_darah.mula: Step into the blood pool and stay. It drinks your life; three demonic waves are coming.
kultivator.gabung.corak.kolam_darah.korb: Your blood runs into the pool. Strength II!
kultivator.gabung.corak.kolam_darah.terl: Your body is too weak for a blood offering.
kultivator.gabung.corak.kolam_darah.tung: The pool waits for room for the next wave...
kultivator.gabung.corak.tiga_cawan.mulai: Three steaming cups before you. Drink one (right-click), smell the scent, then use its antidote herb.
kultivator.gabung.corak.tiga_cawan.aroma: The cup's vapour is %s... Choose its antidote within 20 seconds (right-click a herb).
kultivator.gabung.corak.tiga_cawan.satu_: One cup at a time. Deal with this poison first.
kultivator.gabung.corak.tiga_cawan.benar: The poison fades. The right antidote!
kultivator.gabung.corak.tiga_cawan.salah: Not that one. The antidote was %s.
kultivator.gabung.corak.tiga_cawan.berta: You endured the poison to its end.
kultivator.gabung.corak.ujian_senyap.mul: Night covers you. Take the jade task token from the elders' table and carry it out of the guarded ring (%s blocks) unseen.
It is still light; the guards see farther. Take the jade task token and carry it out of the guarded ring (%s blocks) unseen.
kultivator.gabung.corak.ujian_senyap.gio: Belongs on the elders' table. Carry it out unseen.
kultivator.gabung.corak.ujian_senyap.dia: Jade in hand. Get out of the %s-block ring!
kultivator.gabung.corak.ujian_senyap.hil: The jade task token left your hands.
kultivator.gabung.corak.ujian_senyap.gag: Seen three times. The shadows do not take one so easily seen.
You stand at the Foundation realm: if you wish, right-click the Instructing Disciple before the first cut to challenge them to a friendly sword duel instead of the dummies. A win is full marks.
The friendly duel is only for candidates of the Foundation realm or higher. Cut the dummies.
You have already begun on the dummies; the duel can no longer be chosen.
The duel cannot begin (%s). Cut the dummies.
The Instructing Disciple draws their sword. A friendly sword duel begins; it stops when either of you is down to a tenth of their breath.
